title: 2048 Merge
description: Slide and merge matching tiles to reach 2048! A classic, relaxing number puzzle you can't put down.
author: Game Portal

title: Snake
description: The classic snake game — eat to grow, but don't hit the wall. Arrow keys or swipe to control.
author: Game Portal

title: Brick Breaker
description: Bounce the ball with your paddle to smash every brick. A test of reflexes and angles.
author: Game Portal

title: Memory Match
description: Flip the cards to find the pairs and train your memory. Multiple themed decks.
author: Game Portal

title: Tetris
description: The classic falling-block puzzle — rotate and drop to clear full lines. Speed and planning.
author: Game Portal

title: Minesweeper
description: The classic minesweeper — deduce where every mine is hidden. Logic meets luck.
author: Game Portal

title: Speed Racer
description: Full-width racing! Dodge oncoming traffic on the highway and chase the longest distance. Keyboard or swipe.
author: Game Portal

title: Sky Fighter
description: Side-scrolling shoot 'em up! Pilot your fighter, blast enemy planes with auto-fire, dodge and weave. Mouse/touch.
author: Game Portal

title: Tank Battle
description: Strategy combat! Drive your tank to destroy every enemy and clear level after level. Arrows to move, space to fire.
author: Game Portal

title: Asteroids
description: Classic arcade shooting! Pilot your ship through the asteroid belt, blast rocks and dodge UFO fire. Arrows to steer and thrust, space to fire.
author: Smarty Saini

title: Bouncy Ball
description: A physics bouncing game! Guide the ball as it bounces between walls and obstacles to collect points. Mouse/touch to play.
author: Ritesh Poriya

title: Space Invaders
description: Defend Earth! Shoot down waves of descending aliens and dodge their bullets. Retro arcade cabinet style, touch supported.
author: ShawTim

title: Bubble Shooter
description: Aim, bounce, match three! A physics-based bubble shooter with wall ricochet. Clear bubbles of the same color. Classic arcade feel.
author: ShawTim

title: Tetris 2
description: Another take on Tetris! SRS rotation with wall kicks and 10 difficulty levels. Keyboard and touch controls.
author: ShawTim

title: Memory Cards
description: Classic memory pairing! Flip cards to find matching pictures, with multiple difficulties and high-contrast cards for all ages.
author: bryanherger

title: Bubble Pop
description: Pop the colorful bubbles floating by! Adjustable difficulty, bubble count and speed, satisfying sound effects, touch and keyboard supported.
author: bryanherger

title: Fireworks Show
description: Tap anywhere to launch dazzling fireworks! Real particle physics and gravity, 8 color schemes, the perfect way to relax.
author: bryanherger

title: Music Shapes
description: Tap colorful shapes to play music! Each shape is a note, a cheerful C-major harmony that sparks creativity.
author: bryanherger

title: Picture Puzzle
description: Drag six pieces to complete the picture! Memorize the preview, then scramble. Keyboard also works — trains observation.
author: bryanherger

title: Color Splash
description: Tap anywhere to paint with bold colors and music! Minimal interaction, great for kids to create freely.
author: bryanherger

title: Fruit Slicer
description: Swipe with finger or mouse to slice flying fruit! Classic fruit-cutting fun — beware the bombs 💣, missing fruit costs a life. Combo streaks earn bonus points.
author: GameHub

title: Makeup Studio
description: Give the girl a makeover! Mix and match lipstick, eyeshadow, blush, nails and hairstyle with live preview. Create your signature look.
author: GameHub

title: Dress Up
description: Endless outfit changes! Switch hairstyle, top, bottom and accessories, or tap to randomize a look. Be the trendiest stylist.
author: GameHub

title: Cake Workshop
description: Stack your own cake layer by layer! Pick the base, filling and decorations, then light the candles 🕯️ for your sweet masterpiece.
author: GameHub

title: Endless Runner
description: Infinite runner! Tap to jump over cacti and rocks as the speed ramps up. How many meters can you run?
author: GameHub

title: Watermelon Merge
description: The classic merge game! Drop fruits so matching ones collide and combine into bigger ones, all the way to the 🍉 watermelon. Addictive.
author: GameHub
